2607.03798.title: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
2607.03798.paper_summary: Symmetry is everywhere in nature and society. Geometric deep learning exploits symmetries in data to improve the performance and efficiency of deep learning systems. In this paper, we extend geometric deep learning to utilize richer symmetry structures. Specifically, we develop order-equivariant neural networks (OENN), which generalize standard graph message passing and sheaf neural networks via the theory of equivariant bundles over face posets (face categories). We (i) characterize all linear order-equivariant maps, (ii) build OENN layers, and (iii) prove universal approximation theorems (UATs) for continuous order-equivariant maps, which are new results even when restricted to sheaf neural networks (for which no UAT was known before). We illustrate the framework on graph and sheaf models. Our results can also be seen as extending the known UAT for graph neural networks to a more general setting that subsumes sheaf neural networks as well. In addition, we show that OENN can be extended further to CENN, Category-Equivariant Neural Network, which gives the general form of equivariant neural networks as well as of equivariant universal approximation theorems, allowing us to leverage categorical symmetry in data (e.g., non-invertible symmetries on multiple objects with compositional relations on those symmetries).
2607.03798.paper_summary_zh: 對稱在自然和社會中無處不在。幾何深度學習利用數據中的對稱性來提高深度學習系統的性能和效率。在本文中，我們擴展了幾何深度學習，以利用更豐富的對稱結構。具體而言，我們開發了有序等變神經網絡（OENN），它通過面序列（面類別）上的等變束理論來概括標準圖消息傳遞和束神經網絡。我們（i）描述所有線性有序等變映射，（ii）構建OENN層，以及（iii）證明連續有序等變映射的通用逼近定理（UAT），這些都是新的結果，即使在限制於束神經網絡時（之前對於束神經網絡並不知道UAT）。我們在圖形和束模型上說明了該框架。我們的結果也可以看作是將已知的圖神經網絡的UAT擴展到一個更一般的設置，該設置也包含束神經網絡。此外，我們展示了OENN可以進一步擴展到CENN，即類別等變神經網絡，這提供了等變神經網絡和等變通用逼近定理的一般形式，使我們能夠利用數據中的類別對稱性（例如，具有這些對稱性上組合關係的多個對象的不可逆對稱性）。
2607.03798.author: Yoshihiro Maruyama et.al.
